comments.author: Cobra
comments.body_html:
Raid Overhaul: Use with caution. That mod already changes raid behavior and includes its own random events you can cause over lapping and possible stacking on events and could create a problem within the server. however, ABPS Likely compatible, but again, use with caution both mods can influence bot and boss spawning. you might see larger than expected bot counts or overlapping boss.

so how the mod works.

Each event has its own settings that can modify the raid in different ways, such as:

Changing boss spawn chances or locations (For example, on Factory the default boss is Tagilla. An event OR you Via .JSON can disable Tagilla for that raid and replace him with Reshala (or another configured boss)

Increasing or decreasing AI difficulty (Easy,Medium,Hard,Nightmare)

Adjusting bot spawn behavior

Altering loot distribution

Applying map specific effects (depending on the event) and what you have configured in the .json

Need to kill Killa multiple times for a quest? Configure Killa to be the only boss that spawns on Factory, Need boss guard kills? Done set up an event that spawns bosses with their guards more frequently. Once you’ve completed your objective, simply switch back to your normal event configuration and continue enjoying randomized raid events.

The mod isn’t just about making raids more random it’s also designed to let you tailor raids to your current objectives boss kills guard kills Need to eliminate 250 Raiders for a quest or personal challenge? Enable the Raider event and get ready but be careful it’s an absolute nightmare. 😅

comments.author: Cobra
comments.body_html: Thanks for taking the time to send the log. After reviewing it, I don’t see any evidence that Dynamic Raid Events is causing the crash. Your server is running 71 server-side mods, and there isn’t a stack trace pointing to Dynamic Raid Events as the source of the issue. Dynamic Raid Events does not create, modify, or interact with quests, quest rewards, quest items, or keys. The mod’s purpose is simply to generate and manage dynamic raid events. Because of that, an error involving a “Quest test key” isn’t something this mod would directly produce. Before I make any code changes, I need a reproducible issue on a minimal setup (SPT + Dynamic Raid Events only, or with the fewest additional mods possible). With a heavily modded installation, there are too many variables to determine which mod is responsible. If you can reproduce the issue on a clean install with only Dynamic Raid Events, or provide a stack trace that directly references Dynamic Raid Events, I’ll be happy to investigate it further.

Regarding the loot multipliers, they are not hard-capped by my mod. The event applies the configured multiplier to the game’s existing loot values. The practical limit depends on what the game and other mods are already doing. Reasonable values (such as 1.5× to 3×) should work well, but extremely high multipliers may result in excessive loot or diminishing returns depending on how the underlying loot system handles them.

comments.author: Cobra
comments.body_html:
With Fika what is happening and that i overlooked (but will get fixed in the next update) The server starts the raid → Dynamic Raid Events rolls Cultist Invasion. The host initializes → Dynamic Raid Events rolls Normal Raid. Another player joins → Dynamic Raid Events rolls Cultist Invasion again.

AGAIN it is still safe to run the mod (if u wish to) but what is happening is basically which event “wins.” The last event selected overwrites the previous ones and that’s the one used in the raid. (if that makes sense)
